text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With that, we will now begin the testing 
session for the relaxation goods.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
While there are plenty of reviews, most of 
them discreetly include the line: "*These 
are individual impressions"...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, there is truly no better 
way than to verify it ourselves. 
Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With data available, we can choose the 
most effective option tailored to the 
specific fatigue of the moment.
choice_data_list:
Let's record the effects in as much detail 
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Now, which one shall we try first?
choice_data_list:
I've got my eye on the latest aroma 
diffuser.

Shall we go with the 'Foot Massager' 
today?
A "cushion that ruins the whole world"...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
According to the manual, you can link it 
with the projector's planetarium function 
through the settings.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's turn off the lights and try 
it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now then, setting it to random... and 
start.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see... It really is quite authentic.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The twinkling of the projected stars isn't 
uniform. The video resolution is so 
high... It's gorgeous.
choice_data_list:
Besides... is that a faint scent of the 
sea...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems they use different aromatic 
scents to complement each starry sky 
projection...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose this is like a southern beach 
looking up at the Milky Way... It's truly 
lovely."
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, let's try all kinds of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then... hehe. Shall we divine the 
situation from the stars' alignment and 
the scent of the aroma?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was fully able to enjoy a relaxing time 
orchestrated by the ever-changing starry 
sky and soothing scents. It looks like 
it'll be useful for resting in the future 
too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list:
I can smell it... but the video isn't 
showing up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...A critical fact has come to light. The 
planetarium footage is sold separately as 
DLC."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. Shall we just test 
the fragrance today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the aroma diffuser wasn't bad on its 
own, the high expectations left behind a 
somewhat complicated feeling...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be the very basics of the 
basics.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is important not to let fatigue 
linger in the soles of your feet after 
training. Let us give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This is... quite... Not bad... I'd 
say.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. The way the machine moves is so 
exquisite... pfft.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fatigue recovery effect was modest, 
but seeing Air Messiah burst into laughter 
was a rare treat. It helped her unwind, so 
let's call it a success.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...That is an immensely confident product 
name, isn't it? Let's pray it isn't false 
advertising."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
First, how it feels to the touch... I see. 
It has a texture that combines both plump 
softness and fluffiness...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's smooth... and yet, when touched, it 
clings to the skin... such a sense of 
unity...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, that's not all... Is this... chewy...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, this requires a bit more detailed 
investigation... Yes... since it's a 
cushion, I'll lie down on it... Ahh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as her eyes began to look heavy, she 
finally buried her face in the cushion. 
When I touch the cushion to help her sit 
up—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You touched it too, Trainer... ...Its 
ability to turn people 'useless' is 
terrifyingly real...
choice_data_list: No false advertising on that sign......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ahn... It's making me so sleepy... fufu. 
Since we have the chance, why don't we 
take a little nap...
choice_data_list:
It's for verification purposes, so it 
can't be helped...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she touched the cushion, 
resistance was futile. Its resting power 
lived up to its name. Air Messiah's log 
noted it as '100 points / completely 
helpless'.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... Trainer, you've touched it too, 
haven't you...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though my spirit has been 
freed from my body... ...So this is true 
relaxation..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, "bringer of total ruin" is indeed 
an apt description. Once you've tasted 
such comfort... there is no resisting it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so delightfully comfortable that 
she kept getting sucked into the cushion 
time and again afterward, ultimately 
leaving her unable to fall asleep when 
bedtime rolled around.
